headline: S&P 500 Closes at Record High on Tech Rally
summary: The S&P 500 index closed at a new all-time high of 5,175 points, led by gains in technology and semiconductor stocks.

headline: European Central Bank Signals Rate Cut in June
summary: ECB President Christine Lagarde indicated that a rate reduction is likely at the June meeting if inflation continues to ease toward the 2% target.

headline: Oil Prices Rise on OPEC+ Production Cut Extension
summary: Brent crude oil rose 2.3% to $83.50 per barrel after OPEC+ members agreed to extend voluntary production cuts through the end of Q2 2026.

headline: Apple Announces AI-Powered Features for iOS 19
summary: Apple unveiled a suite of on-device AI features coming to iOS 19, including an enhanced Siri assistant and real-time language translation powered by custom silicon.
